items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Another one was with, a close one was with Chick Webb when he had Ella Fitzgerald when she had just made "A Tiskit a Taskit".

ctx.x: Yes, you see, they had a a very good band and they had Dexter Gordon, Illinois Jacquet, Marshal Royal, Ernie Royal, the whole band was a good band. One of Lionel's best bands. And they had gotten a little cocky. We knew they had a good band but they were going to do so much to us. We always got the message that Lionel is supposed to do this and do that.
But we had the battle and there wasn't any doubt about who won it and nobody, they would always say Lionel had a very good band, but we won the battle.
